rules.statement: The evidence supported the separation, division, and adverse possession of the disputed land by the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd defendants and their predecessors in title.
rules.supporting_quote: There was cogent evidence of separation, division and adverse possession of the land in dispute by the 1st, 2nd and 3rd defendants and their predecessors in title

meta.parties: Jamis Perera and Another v. Charles Dias and Others
